generate_alt_text_from_url.title: Generate alt text from an image URL
generate_alt_text_from_url.description: Fetch a public image URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP or BMP, up to 16 MB, at least 50x50) and generate alt text for it, optionally in another language, length-capped, SEO keyword-steered or product-aware (e-commerce mode). The image is stored on the account under its asset_id. With async=true the call returns at once with an empty alt_text and a job link; fetch the result with get_images_by_job. Use generate_alt_text_from_base64 when you hold the image bytes rather than a URL.

async.description: Process in the background and return immediately (true), or wait for the alt text (false).

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the alt text, e.g. en, de, fr. Defaults to the account's default language.

max_chars.description: Maximum length of the generated alt text, in characters.

asset_id.description: Your own unique identifier for this image; returned as asset_id and usable with get_image and delete_image. Generated by AltTextify when omitted.

keywords.description: English keywords or phrases for SEO-optimised alt text. One or two are used per alt text, but all are considered.

negative_keywords.description: English keywords or phrases the alt text should avoid.

start_with.description: Text the generated alt text must start with.

end_with.description: Text the generated alt text must end with.

domain_context.description: The domain context of the image (what site or subject it belongs to), to steer the wording.

run_ocr.description: E-commerce mode: run OCR on the product to read text printed on it.

product_name.description: E-commerce mode: the name of the product in the image. Any product field switches on the e-commerce vision model.

product_brand.description: E-commerce mode: the brand of the product in the image.

product_color.description: E-commerce mode: the colour of the product in the image.

product_size.description: E-commerce mode: the size of the product in the image.

output.description: The stored image: asset_id, alt_text (empty when async), created_at, async flag and, for async requests, links[] pointing at the job to poll.

links.description: HATEOAS links, e.g. the async_job url.

generate_alt_text_from_base64.title: Generate alt text from base64 image data
generate_alt_text_from_base64.description: Generate alt text for an image supplied as base64-encoded data (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP or BMP, up to 16 MB, at least 50x50), with the same language, length, keyword and e-commerce options as the URL variant. Raw uploads are always processed synchronously, so the alt text comes back in the response. Use generate_alt_text_from_url when the image is publicly reachable.

async.description: Documented by AltTextify but not supported for raw uploads, which always run synchronously; leave false.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the alt text, e.g. en, de, fr. Defaults to the account's default language.

list_images.title: List images
list_images.description: Page through every image stored on the AltTextify account, newest first, each with its asset_id, stored image_source, generated alt_text list, tag and created_at. Use get_image for one known asset id, or get_images_by_job for the results of one async request.

get_images_by_job.title: Get images by job id
get_images_by_job.description: Fetch the images and alt text produced by one async generation job, using the id from the async_job link returned by generate_alt_text_from_url. Returns 404 when the job id does not exist; an empty alt_text means the job has not finished yet.

job_id.description: The job id (the last path segment of the async_job link).

output.description: The images produced by the job, each with job_id, image_source, alt_text, tag and created_at.

get_image.title: Get an image
get_image.description: Fetch one stored image by asset id, with its stored image_source, the generated alt_text list, tag and created_at. Use list_images to browse when you do not know the asset id.

delete_image.title: Delete an image
delete_image.description: Permanently delete a stored image and its generated alt text from the AltTextify account, by asset id. This cannot be undone; copy the alt text first if you still need it.

asset_id.description: The asset id of the image to delete.
